I don’t have live internet access, so I can’t give the current real‑time price.

To see the up‑to‑the‑minute price of Bitcoin (BTC), check a live source such as:
- A major exchange (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, Bitstamp)
- A market tracker (CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko)
- A finance site/app (Yahoo Finance, Google Finance, TradingView)

If you tell me which platform you use, I can walk you through exactly where to look and how to interpret the price (spot, bid/ask, 24h change, etc.).
